test_title: PYST 6: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: RUTW is related to TWVY in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, MPOR is related to ORQT. To which of the given options is VYXA related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'RUTW is related to TWVY'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84d902c816879dd1dd90b748edade9fb9bcd823d2b57dbdedddf095799c8251d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e899acdeb52002cef00a528cb2e4942b5df8ca9957c09befc6647479977476a9.png] 

For, 'MPOR is related to ORQT'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa7f8ef72fa2d5d0e0dff8aa6bc918aec894ed16b3873fcf8a3b3cf2273475fa.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b21c26f845db53824f4fa10e6b22db6f81cac071a2c9a5717b08dad8be60169.png] 

Similarly, for **'VYXA'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c64bc11508db36909cd2497e1e20e72cf6d1d204519500a550de5b64fbc183d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecc99f34b8b69f86344ead3270b314cf0095e0931b6b44cb9f75d9e69783b365.png] 

So, 'VYXA' will be related to **'XAZC'**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
